notes: TBox. The two kinds of flooded valley fix what carved them (formed_by is one-valued here: the queries ask 'a glacier or a river?'). A well-known fjord's membership and its stored glacial origin are separate background facts; each world gives up one per fjord. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30 (carved_by is formed_by). formed_by is many-valued in the catalogue; the questions take one value for granted, which the record states since 2026-10-31 as a bridge of q2 and q3 ('A valley carved by a glacier was not carved by a river.'), encoded as the firm rule glacier_not_river (it replaces the earlier Func(formed_by)).
